hints.text: Direction: use <unk> for missing pieces, keep BOS/EOS, and pad with <pad>. Validator checks: encode should return fixed-length ids and mask.
Pseudocode: Reserve one slot for BOS and EOS, truncate the middle, then pad IDs with 0 and mask positions with 0. Relevant Python syntax: int, raise, ValueError, enumerate, len.
Only encode from the public reference implementation is shown here. Check helper dependencies in the linked reference file when necessary.
hints.code:
def encode(text: str, vocab: list[str], max_length: int = 8):
    if max_length < 2:
        raise ValueError("max_length must leave room for BOS and EOS")
    stoi = {token: index for index, token in enumerate(vocab)}
    body = [stoi.get(piece, stoi["<unk>"]) for piece in word_tokens(text)]
    body = body[: max_length - 2]
    ids = [stoi["<bos>"], *body, stoi["<eos>"]]
    mask = [1] * len(ids)
    pad_count = max_length - len(ids)
    ids.extend([stoi["<pad>"]] * pad_count)
    mask.extend([0] * pad_count)
    return ids, mask
